text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
At the training track after a day of heavy
rain...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I tripped and fell straight into a puddle
on my
way here...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ugh! And I'd even hyped myself up to
make sure I
wouldn't let the rain get me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to that, I think I've lost all my

motivation...
